title: GOTCHA: overlay.js save() writes LOCAL_FIELDS only — new fields silently disappear on restart if misrouted
summary: Discovered when edges dropped to 0 after daemon restart (2026-06-11): overlay.js save() uses an explicit LOCAL_FIELDS allowlist. Only 8 fields survive to overlay JSON: git, cancel_requested, stop_requested, config, judgedAtEpoch, judgeCursor, judgedClusters, distinctClusters. ALL other fields (assignee, timestamps, metrics, measurements, benchmarks, repos, edges, status, summaries, knowledge, note_nodes, snapshots) are SHARED — they go to graph-store via emitDiff() as append-only JSONL events in .graph/nodes/<id>.jsonl. Measured on real data: 839 edges missing from /state after restart until load() rehydration fixed. Adding a new field diagnostics: if it belongs in LOCAL_FIELDS (ephemeral runtime), add to the array in save(). If it is durable knowledge (survives restart, cross-session), add an event to emitDiff() and a case in graph-store.js loadGraph() — putting it in LOCAL_FIELDS causes silent data loss on restart (exits 0, no error).
